name: Wooden Rattle & Shaker Set
description: Handcrafted wooden rattles and shakers designed for safe sensory exploration, gentle sound stimulation, and early motor skill development.

name: Kathakali Doll Set
description: Add a touch of Indian heritage to your space with this beautifully handcrafted set of 4 Kathakali wooden dolls. Each doll stands at 12cm tall and is meticulously hand-painted with vibrant colors, capturing the essence of Kerala's classical dance-drama. Perfect as a unique cultural decor piece for your home or office desk, or as a thoughtful gift for art and culture enthusiasts.

name: Yakshagana Doll Set
description: Authentic wooden Yakshagana doll set handcrafted by Channapatna artisans using eco-friendly natural dyes. Includes premium hand-finished detailing and comes with a reusable gift box. A perfect representation of Karnataka’s traditional art form.

name: Vintage Wooden Car
description: Spark your child's imagination with this charming vintage wooden toy car. Crafted with a classic red and natural wood finish, it features smooth-rolling wheels perfect for little hands. Measuring 20 cm in length and 6 cm in height, this durable, eco-friendly toy is ideal for toddlers and preschoolers aged 3 to 5 years. A timeless and sturdy addition to any playroom.
